name: plannotator
description: Interactive plan and code review for Codex: annotate plans, diffs, and markdown in the browser, then send structured feedback back to the agent. Ships the core Plannotator skills and an optional Stop hook for plan review.

interface.shortDescription: Browser-based plan and code review for Codex
interface.longDescription: Open plans, git diffs, and documents in Plannotator's annotation UI. Approve, request changes, or send structured feedback back to Codex. Includes $plannotator-review, $plannotator-annotate, $plannotator-last, $plannotator-inbox, and the plannotator reference skill, plus an optional Stop hook that opens plan review when a Codex turn ends with a plan.
defaultPrompt: Open Plannotator code review for my current changes
Annotate this markdown file with Plannotator
Review the last reply in Plannotator
